    Lemma 2.5 in the opposite category #

    "Applying these arguments to the opposite module category proves exactness of the second sequence in (1) and the assertion at injective labels." This file transfers the hypotheses of the abstract Lemma 2.5 (StrictLayers.strict) to Cᵒᵖ:

    • the categorical radical and its powers are self-dual (isRadicalMorphism_op_iff, mem_Ipow_op_iff);
    • the Krull–Schmidt target normal form of C (split epimorphism and radical map) is the source normal form of Cᵒᵖ (hasSplitRadicalNormalForm_op);
    • a left tau-sequence Y → E → T with epic second map is a right radical approximation of Y in Cᵒᵖ (approxOfLeftTau).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.

          RightRadicalApprox (Opposite.op Y)

          A complex Y → E → T with the radical approximation property, whose epic second map is a weak cokernel of the first (a left tau-sequence), is a right radical approximation of Y in Cᵒᵖ: dually, every radical map out of Y factors through f, and every map in I²(T, Z) is q ∘ g with q radical.
